purpose: Observe production table-specialist routing, specialist output, and post-assembly ownership without changing baseline semantics.

invocation_modes.PAGE_WIDE: No table-labelled layout region was supplied; the table detector was invoked on the complete page image.
invocation_modes.LABELLED_CROP: At least one layout region with raw label exactly equal to table was supplied; structure recognition was invoked on that region crop and page-wide detection was skipped.
invocation_modes.NOT_INVOKED: The table specialist did not execute because it was unavailable, lacked a rendered image, or failed during model setup before specialist inference. This is not evidence of a detector miss.

record_kinds.specialist_invocation: One table-backend decision with detector/structure subcalls, pre-treatment regions, outputs, warnings, errors, timings, and model provenance.
record_kinds.page_assembly: Post-specialist production merge facts: table-element ownership, overlap candidates, duplicate/unowned states, final IR identifiers, reading order, and notes. Never a selector feature.

pre_treatment_routing_fields: ocr child count when supplied by the caller
selector_exclusion_rule: GT identity/geometry, strict-D2 status, detector or structure outcome, treatment recovery/conflict, post-treatment ownership, and held-out outcomes are forbidden selector inputs.
write_contract: The recorder is in-memory during execution and writes one complete JSON payload through a temporary file plus atomic replace. A partial file is not a valid completed run.
